reviewed_by: Claude review of SSH environments from ~/.ssh/config
reason: New SSH environments feature: Core reads ~/.ssh/config (ssh -G for resolved facts), stores per-host SshEnvironment settings, exposes /api/v1/ssh-environments, and turns enabled hosts into ssh.<host>.run_command broker tools with ask/allow approval; chat gains ssh_environment_ids and snapshots hosts for approval resume. UI adds Settings > Environments, a host details dialog, a composer host picker, a host-aware approval card and activity labels. Selected: the new backend tests (parsing, service, API, broker approve-then-run), the chat tool loop, MCP probing and chat API (shared runtime_platform/chat paths), domain and CRUD validation (new entity/custom resource), the Playwright impact manifest test; frontend tests for the new components and the client, ledger and MCP settings they touch; the new real-Core environments journey on all eight assistant-real projects plus the mocked assistant-settings journey that exercises the composer.
exclusions: No full suites. Native unchanged. The browser journey uses a real Core with scripted connection tests (no sshd in CI); real ssh probing was checked manually against two LAN Macs. The provider-chat round trip (model calls a host tool, approval card, remote run) is covered by the broker approve-then-run test and component tests, not by a browser journey.
